column1: # ZAP baseline scan triage for the secure DB access gateway edge.
# Format is ZAP's own -c format: id<TAB>LEVEL<TAB>justification, one per line,
# at least three tab-separated fields. A malformed line makes zap-baseline.py
# exit 3, so keep it strictly tab-separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Rules NOT listed here keep ZAP's default level of WARN, and `fail_action: true`
# turns any WARN into a failed build. That is deliberate: only alerts we have
# consciously decided about are listed, so anything new still blocks. Do not
# bulk-ignore rule ids here; add a line only with a written justification.
# 10016 - Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled
#   The X-XSS-Protection header is deliberately not set. It is deprecated and
#   removed from modern browsers, and its audit filter has itself been an XSS
#   vector; the Content-Security-Policy header on this edge is the control that
#   replaces it. Recorded in SECURITY.md as an intentional omission.

column3: X-XSS-Protection is intentionally not set; it is deprecated and superseded by the Content-Security-Policy header (see SECURITY.md).
